name: replate
description: RePlate connects surplus food with nearby NGOs before it goes to waste.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c green,blue "npm run dev -w @replate/web" "npm run dev -w @replate/api"
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.db:types: supabase gen types typescript --linked --schema public > apps/api/src/db/database.types.ts
